snippet.title: My Femboy Roommate: Special Weekend - Teaser
snippet.description:
My Femboy Roommate: Special Weekend

You take your roommate turned boyfriend, Robin, to a fancy resort for your one year anniversary. Explore and enjoy everything the high-end resort has to offer while bonding and getting closer to Robin. Will you make the most of this special weekend?

Story:

In this sequel to My Femboy Roommate, you take your roommate turned boyfriend, Robin, to a fancy resort for your one year anniversary.

Explore and enjoy everything the high-end resort has to offer while bonding and growing closer to Robin. Lounge by the pool, indulge in the amenities, and make new connections—all while preparing something unforgettable to close off your weekend with Robin.

How will you spend your special weekend with Robin?

You can expect:

- Full, original English voice acting for all story scenes and events
- Collectibles and mini-games that unlock new scenes
- Animated CGs for most spicy scenes
- Translations for multiple languages
- An alternate storyline that is unlocked once the base game is completed
- A full replay gallery where you can unlock and replay all unlocked scenes

AVN Games Discord: https://discord.gg/UBGVFggnkX

Genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation
Developer: Nuteku - https://www.patreon.com/Nutekuu | https://x.com/Nuteku_
Publisher: Nuteku, Softboi Games - https://discord.gg/u9GwfyjJNs
Release Date: June 2025

Other Games: http://youtu.be/UY8GsJY4bK8
